readiness.approved_activation_scope: Official eligibility plus explicitly unofficial HYMS-specific estimate-mode interview guidance.
engine_assumptions: National UCAT deciles from the shared official UCAT dataset are used as an estimate input.
The supplied third-party component tariffs and recommendation bands are directional estimates.
Contextual estimate points are available only to Home UK school-leavers without graduate or prior-university status.
do_not_infer: Do not describe any estimated score as HYMS-published or official.
Do not present estimate bands as current HYMS cut-offs, probabilities or guarantees.
Do not award contextual estimate points to international, graduate or prior-university applicants.
Do not infer unverified international qualification equivalence.

eligibility.summary: The applicant meets every supported official HYMS eligibility rule represented by the supplied evidence.

stage_2_selection.summary: HYMS ranks eligible applicants using GCSE, UCAT decile and SJT components, with contextual points available only to qualifying Home UK school-leavers. ApplySmart labels every calculated tariff and recommendation as an unofficial estimate.

confidence.summary: Official eligibility rules are separated from a low-confidence, unofficial estimate of HYMS selection points and recommendation bands.

evidence_confidence.summary: The recommendation is supported by core admissions evidence, with some historical or route-specific limits.
reasons: The university selection approach is implemented.
